body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports a defstruct field typed as another already-registered struct, closing one of the two gaps flagged the moment defstruct support first landed. Threaded known-structs through the whole struct-field emission chain, reusing the same registry param-c-type already established. A struct-typed field's struct must be declared earlier in the file -- the same real requirement plain C imposes on by-value struct nesting, not an arbitrary scope choice. Found and fixed a real double-space formatting bug while verifying (copied param-c-type's trailing-space convention into a sibling function with the opposite convention). 7 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check proving a genuinely nested struct read produces the correct value at runtime. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit d30617e.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: struct-typed struct field support
